## 2\. add a logo for your own LLM in frontend

* add your logo svg to `web/src/assets/svg/llm` (for example: `web/src/assets/svg/llm/myownllm.svg` )
* link the svg to the LLM factory by adding an entry in [`web/src/constants/setting.ts`](https://github.com/6chaoran/ragflow/blob/4c5f5a0e393cf93e4ac84e9c0cd12e50b3e002c6/web/src/constants/setting.ts) .

```

## 3\. add your LLM into `LocalLLMFactories` for frontend

* add an entry to register in `LocalLlmFactories` in `web/src/pages/user-setting/constants.tsx`

```

```
* add an entry to `optionsMap` in `web/src/pages/user-setting/setting-model/ollama-modal/index.tsx`

```
// web/src/pages/user-setting/setting-model/ollama-modal/index.tsx const optionsMap = { MyOwnLLM : [ // [MyOwnLLM] { value : ' chat ' , label : ' chat ' }, ], HuggingFace : [ { value : ' embedding ' , label : ' embedding ' }, { value : ' chat ' , label : ' chat ' },] // ... }
```

```
